arrangementNote: Independent whole-song practice arrangement in A minor. No vocal melody, guitar riff or lyrics are reproduced; this is not a recording-synchronized transcription.

arrangementNote: Independent complete learning arrangement, transposed down four semitones from C-sharp minor into A minor. Each + sign splits one bar into two equal two-beat chords. Repeats, spoken-intro accompaniment and the final tonic are authored practice choices.

arrangementNote: Independent 4/4 accompaniment for Con te partirò / Time to Say Goodbye, transposed from G to C with the final whole-step lift retained as C to D. This song is not a four-chord-only original: its final section requires D, A, Bm, G and Em, and the introduction adds G7. Some passing inversions and suspensions are reduced to basic chords. The chart is an authored learning cover with regularized bar lengths and a finite coda, not an exact transcription of any Bocelli/Brightman performance; rubato and melody are omitted.

arrangementNote: Independent full learning cover in C. Verse changes are placed two chords per bar, while the bridge opens out to one chord per bar; this contrast is corroborated by the Australian SongMakers teaching resource (songmakers.com.au/vet/songwriting/song-form/bridge/). Dm is retained in the pre-chorus and interlude. The source's disputed outro B/A chords are simplified to the familiar C/G/Am/F family. Repeats, regularized pauses and the finite ending are authored learning choices, not a recording-synchronized transcription.
